entries.scene: The forest escape route outside the Cyprus hospital during Mission 00 of The Phantom Pain, matching the actual provided gameplay shot. OMIT the player, horse and Man on Fire. The flames belong to the environment and are behind the combat lane, not across it. One clear level horizontal dirt foreground trail with the burning pine forest in the background, allowing the original nighttime orange/black atmosphere. Do not include hospital interior, graves or tombstones not visible in the reference. This source represents ONLY the forest road segment of the chase.
